Package game.actors

Class ConsciousActor

java.lang.Object
edu.monash.fit2099.engine.GameEntity
edu.monash.fit2099.engine.actors.Actor
game.actors.ConsciousActor
All Implemented Interfaces:
Printable
Direct Known Subclasses:
Crow, Farmer, WanderingActor
public abstract class ConsciousActor extends Actor
Base class for actors that can only act while they are conscious.

Every turn it first checks whether the actor has run out of hit points; if so, the actor falls unconscious and does nothing. Otherwise the turn is handed to playConsciousTurn(edu.monash.fit2099.engine.actions.ActionList, edu.monash.fit2099.engine.actions.Action, edu.monash.fit2099.engine.positions.GameMap, edu.monash.fit2099.engine.displays.Display), which each subclass implements with its own way of choosing an action (a menu for the player, a behaviour or a state machine for other actors). This keeps the unconscious check in a single place.
